executive_summary: The June-3 'wiring not building' conclusion has been acted on. Every High/Medium built-but-not-wired item is now consumed by a real screen; the cockpit grew from ~25 to 90 routes (all additive, owner gates intact); device pairing (#319) landed; device-control hardening (#4/#5) is implemented and locally unit-verified on open PRs #324/#325 but not yet merged. Remaining work is hardening, dependency hygiene, and on-device verification — not new surfaces. The top new finding is 26 Dependabot vulnerabilities (7 high).
